title: Habib Ships Out Judkins for Douglas, and Luffy Hits the Panic Button for Him
dek: Kaushal sent Quinshon Judkins to The Horse is Hea for DeMario Douglas before Week 10, and the numbers say Sonny got the running back while Habib took a 32-point plunge in playoff odds.
body: The trade nobody saw coming landed before Week 10: Habibsters sent running back Quinshon Judkins to The Horse is Hea, and Kaushal got wide receiver DeMario Douglas back. It's a one-for-one swap. Judkins came in with 81.1 points on the season and nine weeks on a roster, so he's been a fixture all year. Douglas has 16.5 points and has spent only two weeks on anybody's roster, which makes him the kind of player who usually changes hands on waiver night, not in a trade.

Start with Sonny's side, because it's the simple one. He adds a running back with a real body of work to a roster that was already sitting at 89% playoff odds, and Luffy nudged his title chances from 17% to 18%. His playoff odds didn't move at all, which tells you this deal wasn't about getting in. It was about what The Horse is Hea looks like in December, and a Civ player knows the value of picking up a resource the other side wasn't using.

Habib's side is where Luffy got loud. Habibsters' title odds fell from 19% to 5%, and their playoff odds dropped from 78% to 46%, from comfortably in to the wrong side of a coin flip on one transaction. That's a team that had just climbed from 1-4 to 5-4 on a four-game run, and the trade took away the strongest part of its case. Maybe Kaushal sees something in Douglas that hasn't shown up in the box score, or maybe the receiver room needed a body more than the backfield needed Judkins. Either way, the numbers are not on his side yet.

On paper, this is a clear win for Sonny. He gave up a player with 16.5 points, took on one with 81.1, and his title odds went up while Habib's crashed by 14 points. Douglas has a lot of catching up to do, and Habib has the next few weeks to prove Luffy wrong. Sonny gets to sit back and check whether Judkins helps a team that keeps leaving points on the bench.

social.text: Welcome to the stable, Quinshon Judkins. 81.1 points and counting, and now he's ours. #HorseIsHea

social.author: Dr. Nina Kessler
social.text: Judkins-for-Douglas, per Luffy: Habibsters title odds 19% to 5%, playoff odds 78% to 46%. The Horse is Hea title odds 17% to 18%. One side of this deal moved the needle, and it wasn't toward Kaushal.

social.author: Horse Sense
social.text: 81.1 points for 16.5. We'd like to thank Habib for his generous contribution to the Buckaroo Bowl IV fund.

social.author: Waiver Wire Whisperer
social.text: DeMario Douglas has been on a roster for two weeks. Habib turned a guy I'd have grabbed for free into his RB1 going out the door. Four-game win streak, meet the trade button.

social.author: Dawg Pound BFL
social.text: Sonny is now at 89% playoff odds with an extra running back and still leaves 35 points on his bench. Somebody please trade with Kai like this.
